events.title: Node.js 20 released
events.summary: Node.js 20.0.0 shipped on April 18, 2023 with a stable test runner, permission model preview, and V8 11.3.
events.about: Node 20 became the active LTS line in October 2023 — the baseline for serverless runtimes, Next.js deployments, and npm packages through 2025. Built-in `node:test` reduced reliance on Jest for simple suites; the permission model previewed sandboxed file and network access.

narrative.whyChosen: Node 20 was the LTS foundation for mid-2020s JavaScript backends.
narrative.whyImportant: Stable test runner and permission APIs moved Node toward safer production defaults.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams needed a long-supported runtime with modern V8 and first-party testing tools.
